description: What in this repository belongs to the template rather than to a project built from it. `npm run setup` reads this file once, in a new project, and prunes, replaces, and renames accordingly. Anything added to this repository that is template-only must be added here in the same change; test/contracts/manifest.template-only.test.js fails on a path that no longer exists and on a template-only contract test that is missing from `prune`.

placeholders.PROJECT_NAME: The project slug, which is also the base Worker name — for example `acme-bot`.
placeholders.PROJECT_DESCRIPTION: One line saying what the bot does, for the README heading and package.json.
placeholders.TEMPLATE_REPOSITORY: The upstream template's repository URL, for provenance and for links back to the full setup guide.
placeholders.TEMPLATE_VERSION: The template version the project was created from, taken from package.json at setup time.
